description: This file defines a ASP.NET Core API controller named SecretsController responsible for managing secret entities. It provides endpoints for creating, retrieving, updating, decrypting, and deleting secrets, utilizing dependency injection for database context and logging, and performing encryption/decryption operations.

classes.name: SecretsController
classes.description: ASP.NET Core API controller for managing secret entities, including creation, retrieval, update, decryption, and deletion.

methods.name: CreateOne
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new secret, encrypting the secret value and saving metadata to the database.

methods.name: GetSecret
methods.description: Retrieves a secret by its ID, returning 404 if not found.

methods.name: GetMany
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of secrets, with an optional limit parameter.

methods.name: GetOne
methods.description: Decrypts and returns the secret's value after verifying the provided password.

methods.name: PatchOne
methods.description: Updates an existing secret with new data, including re-encrypting the secret value.

methods.name: DeleteOne
methods.description: Deletes a secret by its ID with auditing.
